dem longissime inter se diversum recitandi

ex his turbis te expedies.

page.notes: The catchword "mo-" was read at the lower right. The faint mark at the lower left is too unclear to read as a signature and is left out. Doubtful readings: "Dissertatione" (printed "Differtatione"), read as ss under the long-s rule. "Patriarchiis" (printed "Patriarchijs"), with the j read as a vowel i. Long s was normalised to s throughout, and u/v and i/j were normalised as the rules require.
